# mcp-einvoicing-be

> MCP server for Belgian electronic invoicing (Peppol BIS 3.0, UBL 2.1, PINT-EU, Mercurius)

## Docs

- [Overview](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-be/): what this server does and how to install it
- [Installation](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-be/installation/): install via uvx
- [Configuration](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-be/configuration/): required environment variables
- [Tools](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-be/tools/): full MCP tool reference
- [Standards](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-be/standards/): standards and profiles implemented
- [Changelog](https://cmendezs.github.io/mcp-einvoicing-be/changelog/): version history
